turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so start with who decided that, and when.
I didn't come here to be thanked, Hale. I'm waiting.
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.
What file, Hale, on what date, and whose account? "612 words appeared at 11:52 PM" means nothing to me until I can read it myself, so turn the screen around.
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
You're leading me, Hale, and I don't do arithmetic on numbers I haven't seen. Show me the document with a date on it, or tell me that's all you have.
What time is it now, by the way?
Nearly twenty past four, which leaves you about twenty minutes before my call. Spend them on that document.
